decisions.reason: Substantial line investment and public launch make management reluctant to abandon this sports-floor system despite weak recent visibility.
The multi-model mobile arena line represents significant sunk costs and can attribute poor demand to temporary pandemic effects, so it stays.
Similar committed resources and public launch justify persistence even if results have disappointed.
Chevron parquet is central to the announced trend-led style direction and received homepage prominence, so exit is very unlikely.
As a low-investment, peripheral finish with no strong public commitment, disappointing results make it easier to cut.
Oak skirting is a small accessory with limited sunk costs and low centrality, so the firm can drop it to release resources.
